description: Shared pHloat remote upload contract used by relay firmware, Google Apps Script, and Tilt Pi server.

google_apps_script.notes: Deploy GoogleAppsScript.js as a web app (Execute as: Me, Anyone). Set PHLOAT_UPLOAD_SECRET in Script Properties.

tilt_pi.notes: Set upload_secret in config.json or PHLOAT_UPLOAD_SECRET env var. HTTP allowed on local network.

response.tilt_matched: boolean (Tilt Pi and GAS when Tilt data found)
